svg.title: ServiceForge monorepo structure showing six major directories
svg.desc: Structural diagram of the monorepo: pkg shared libraries, services with 7 microservices, web frontend, sdks, deploy infrastructure, and tools

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the pkg/ shared libraries in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain the services/ directory structure for each microservice')
sendPrompt('Explain the web/ frontend structure with Next.js app router')
sendPrompt('Explain the SDK structure and how SDKs are auto-generated')
sendPrompt('Explain the deploy/ infrastructure setup with Helm, Terraform, and Docker')
sendPrompt('Explain the tools/ directory and developer scripts')
